title: Cruise Control and Lane-Keeping Feedback
summary: Feedback centers on adaptive or auto cruise control and lane-keeping, with clear praise for smooth operation in some reviews, clear complaints about faults or unsafe behavior in others, and many fragments that mention these features without enough context to assign a definite sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise auto or adaptive cruise control and lane keeping for working smoothly, easily, or excellently in driving use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews report cruise-control-related fault messages and describe the lane-keeping assistant as dangerous on narrow roads and hard to disable.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention cruise control or lane keeping working well, being fiddly, being unavailable, or being desired, but the examples do not provide enough context to classify them consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a sharper sentiment summary.
Some undetermined examples appear clearly favorable or unfavorable in wording, but their assigned sentiment is undetermined and must be kept separate.
The topic combines related driver-assistance functions such as cruise control, adaptive cruise, lane keeping, and feature availability, which may reflect more than one subtopic.
